heading_en: Maintaining the Integrity of the Procedures for Allocating Retail Exposures to Pools
summary_ja: リテール向けエクスポージャーの各プールの損失特性及び延滞状況並びに個々の債務者の状況を年一回以上見直す。
summary_en: Requires at least annual review of each pool's loss characteristics and delinquency status and of the status of individual obligors within pools.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall review the loss characteristics and delinquency status of each pool for retail exposures at least once a year.

In order to confirm that each retail exposure continues to be allocated to an appropriate pool, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall review the status of individual obligors within each pool at least once a year, by examining representative samples of the retail exposures belonging to that pool or by other methods.
